name: Rigatona
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rigatona, also written Rigantona, is a cross-reference in the encyclopedia. The entry does not stand alone. It directs the reader to the separate entry for Rhiannon.

okr.objective: Rigatona is a cross-reference pointing to the entry on Rhiannon.
key_results: Rigatona is an alternate spelling of the name.
The entry sends the reader to Rhiannon.
It holds no facts of its own.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
